Web check of 2026-07-27, searched in the country's own language. No establishment retained, and the exclusion here is more informative than the zero. The four Dutch higher theatre schools identified, ArtEZ Arnhem, AHK Amsterdam, Zuyd Maastricht and HKU Utrecht, show no puppetry stream: AHK's courses are acting and cabaret, mime, scenography, directing, design and technology, and production. The only specialised training identified is the Puppet and Object Theatre course at the Haags Theaterhuis in The Hague, which awards a certificate from the Dutch UNIMA puppetry association. The denominator excludes it: an association certificate is not a higher education award backed by a state institution. Method caveat: this description of the Haags Theaterhuis comes from a search summary, the page itself not having been readable. Confidence therefore stays at estimate. Upper bound raised from 0 to 1. This country is a textbook case of the bias flagged in the schema, where vitality runs through companies rather than institutions. Revisited on 2026-07-27 after the two rulings of the same day. Neither turns the file, but one sentence had to be restated. The Haags Theaterhuis was excluded because an association certificate is not a higher education award backed by a state institution, a formula that quotes a denominator which no longer exists. The exclusion survives its rewriting: the test is now that the award be state-recognised, and a certificate issued by the Dutch UNIMA association is not one, whoever owns the training. The object theatre ruling does not save it either, since what fails here is the award and not the discipline — the course is squarely puppet and object theatre. The method caveat stands untouched and is the real weakness of this file: the description of the Haags Theaterhuis still comes from a search summary, its own page never having been read, so nothing here is established at source about what it actually awards. Confidence stays at estimated for that reason and not for any other.
